args.name: mcp
args.description: Run the stdio MCP entry instead of the GUI: a running, MCP-enabled app serves the tools; with no app, run `--headless` for the core-native server

args.name: headless
args.description: Force the core-native headless MCP server (no window)

args.name: json
args.description: Emit the catalog as JSON (default: an id/section/title table)

analyze.description: Decode file(s) and run analyzer(s) over a window

args.name: file
args.description: Audio file(s) to decode and analyze

args.name: tool
args.description: Analyzer id to run (repeatable); required unless --all

args.name: all
args.description: Run every analyzer in the catalog

args.name: start
args.description: Window start in seconds (default 0)

args.name: end
args.description: Window end in seconds (default: full duration)

args.name: param
args.description: Shared param patch K=V (repeatable): fftSize, hop, windowFn, channel, resampleTo, freqMinHz, freqMaxHz, randomizedOverlap

args.name: option
args.description: Per-tool option patch [TOOL.]K=V (repeatable)

args.name: filter
args.description: Apply a filter GraphSpec (JSON file) before analysis

args.name: full
args.description: Include the raw result arrays (default: compacted)

args.name: pretty
args.description: Pretty-print a single result instead of one JSON line per result

args.name: fail-fast
args.description: Stop at the first failing file/tool

synth.description: Render a synth graph and (optionally) analyze the result

args.name: graph
args.description: Synth GraphSpec (JSON file) to render

args.name: seconds
args.description: Rendered length in seconds (default 5)

args.name: tool
args.description: Analyzer id to run (repeatable); omit to print the rendered source summary

args.name: all
args.description: Run every analyzer in the catalog

args.description: Window start in seconds

args.description: Window end in seconds

args.description: Shared param patch K=V (repeatable)

args.name: option

args.description: Apply a filter GraphSpec (JSON file) before analysis

args.description: Include the raw result arrays

args.name: pretty
args.description: Pretty-print a single result

args.description: Stop at the first failing tool

notes.description: List the notes in a project file (.heyl)

args.name: file
args.description: Project file (.heyl) to read the notes from

args.name: json
args.description: Emit each note as one JSON line (JSONL) instead of a table

args.name: full
args.description: Include the full markdown body (default: a one-line excerpt)
